{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "In-plane design envelope and aspect ratio",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 7.1.1 assigns the design domain to Fig. 6(a). Sec. 5 specifies element counts, not physical dimensions or aspect ratio. Let L and H denote the modeled width and height.",
      "readings": [
        "Square rectangle: L/H = 1",
        "Wide rectangle: L/H = 2",
        "Tall rectangle: L/H = 0.5"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Full-domain versus symmetry-reduced representation",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The text does not establish whether Fig. 6(a) represents the complete structure or a symmetry-reduced portion, nor what physical span the 100-by-100 mesh covers.",
      "readings": [
        "The mesh covers the complete beam of span L",
        "The mesh covers half of a beam of full span 2L, with a symmetry boundary at x = 0"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Absolute in-plane dimensions and units",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 5 and 8 give a 100-by-100 discretization but no dimensional length scale. These alternatives assume fixed aspect ratio and unchanged filter size relative to the mesh.",
      "readings": [
        "L = 1 m, with H set by the chosen aspect ratio",
        "L = 100 mm, with the same aspect ratio"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Support locations, number, and spatial extent",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 7.1.1 supplies no support coordinates or supported boundary lengths; boundary conditions are assigned to Fig. 6(a).",
      "readings": [
        "Point supports at the two lower corners, (0,0) and (L,0)",
        "Support patches spanning two bottom-edge elements at each end",
        "The entire left edge plus a point support at the lower-right corner",
        "The entire left edge alone"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_type",
      "entity": "Constrained displacement components",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The boundary-condition symbols in Fig. 6(a) are unavailable, and Sec. 7.1.1 does not specify which displacement components are restrained.",
      "readings": [
        "Left pin: ux = uy = 0; right vertical roller: uy = 0",
        "Both end supports pinned: ux = uy = 0",
        "Left symmetry edge: ux = 0; lower-right support: uy = 0",
        "Left edge clamped: ux = uy = 0"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Mid-load application position",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The name 'mid-load' does not identify a coordinate or boundary. Sec. 7.1.1 assigns the applied load to Fig. 6(a).",
      "readings": [
        "Top-edge midpoint: (L/2,H)",
        "Right-edge midpoint: (L,H/2)",
        "Interior geometric center: (L/2,H/2)",
        "Top of a symmetry cut in a half-domain model: (0,H)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Spatial distribution of the applied force",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Secs. 4.1 and 7.1.1 do not state whether the force shown in Fig. 6(a) is concentrated or distributed, or how it is assembled into nodal loads.",
      "readings": [
        "Entire resultant applied to one node",
        "Resultant shared equally among three adjacent nodes centered on the load position",
        "Uniform traction over a boundary segment of length 0.02L centered on the load position"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "Applied force vector",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 establishes that the load is constant during optimization, but its direction and sign are left to Fig. 6(a).",
      "readings": [
        "Vertically downward: (Fx,Fy) = (0,-F)",
        "Horizontal: (Fx,Fy) = (-F,0)",
        "Oblique: (Fx,Fy) = (F/sqrt(2),-F/sqrt(2))"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Applied force resultant",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither Sec. 4.1 nor Sec. 7.1.1 gives a numerical force magnitude or force units.",
      "readings": [
        "F = 1 N",
        "F = 1000 N"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Passive solid or void mask",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No mid-load-specific passive-region mask or explicit statement that all cells are designable appears in Secs. 4.1, 5, or 7.1.1.",
      "readings": [
        "No passive regions; all 10000 elements are designable",
        "Elements incident to load and support nodes are fixed solid",
        "Two-element-thick solid pads are retained around load and support locations"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Volume accounting if passive regions are present",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Fig. 8 and Sec. 7.1.1 fix the fraction at 0.25, but Eq. (4) gives no accounting rule for any unspecified passive regions.",
      "readings": [
        "Total solid volume, including passive solids, is limited to 25% of the complete modeled domain",
        "Designable elements receive a 25% volume budget, with passive solids excluded from that budget"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Solid Young's modulus E1",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 defines E1 in Eq. (3) but supplies no value. These alternatives hold E0/E1 and the other material parameters fixed.",
      "readings": [
        "E1 = 1 in consistent normalized units",
        "E1 = 210 GPa"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Ersatz-void stiffness relative to solid stiffness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (3) introduces E0, but neither E0 nor the ratio E0/E1 is reported.",
      "readings": [
        "E0/E1 = 1e-9",
        "E0/E1 = 1e-6",
        "E0/E1 = 1e-3"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 specifies Young's-modulus interpolation but gives no Poisson's ratio for the elastic element stiffness.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform nu = 0.25",
        "Uniform nu = 0.30",
        "Uniform nu = 0.45"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 specifies bilinear quadrilateral elements without stating whether their elasticity matrix uses plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress",
        "Plane strain"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No thickness or per-unit-thickness convention is stated for the two-dimensional model. These alternatives hold total applied nodal forces fixed.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit thickness in the chosen length units",
        "Uniform thickness t = 1 mm",
        "Uniform thickness t = 10 mm"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Operation represented by ft = 1",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 5 fixes ft = 1 but does not define that selector or supply the referenced top88 filtering equations, leaving its translation to an independent solver unspecified.",
      "readings": [
        "Filter objective sensitivities before updating the design variables",
        "Filter design densities before evaluating stiffness and physical volume"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Units and distance metric for rmin = 2.4",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 5 gives rmin = 2.4 without defining its units or distance metric, which matters if physical element widths and heights differ.",
      "readings": [
        "Radius 2.4 measured in element-index Euclidean distance",
        "Physical circular radius equal to 2.4 element widths",
        "Physical circular radius equal to 2.4 element heights"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Filter kernel, normalization, and boundary treatment",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 5 supplies filter parameters without a weighting formula or treatment of exterior and symmetry boundaries.",
      "readings": [
        "Cone weights max(0,rmin-distance), truncated and renormalized at every modeled boundary",
        "Uniform weights inside the radius, truncated and renormalized",
        "Cone weights with reflected neighbors across a symmetry boundary"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Low-density regularization of a sensitivity filter",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "If ft = 1 is implemented as a density-weighted sensitivity filter, Sec. 5 does not specify any denominator regularization near rho = 0.",
      "readings": [
        "Divide by max(rho,0.001)",
        "Divide by max(rho,0.000001)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Quadrilateral stiffness integration",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 fixes bilinear quadrilateral elements and Sec. 5 fixes 100-by-100 elements, but their quadrature and stabilization are not stated in the supplied text.",
      "readings": [
        "Fully integrated Q4 elements using 2-by-2 Gauss quadrature",
        "Reduced-integration Q4 elements using one Gauss point with hourglass stabilization"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Explicit design symmetry on a full-domain mesh",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 7.1.1 does not state whether a full-domain solve permits independent densities or imposes mirrored design variables.",
      "readings": [
        "All 10000 element densities are independent",
        "Mirror corresponding element densities across x = L/2 during optimization"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial density field",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 4.1, 5, and 7.1.1 do not state how the top88 optimization for volume fraction 0.25 is initialized.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform rho = 0.25",
        "Alternating rho = 0.24 and 0.26 with mean 0.25",
        "Warm start from the optimized design at volume fraction 0.24"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Density update algorithm and damping",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 4.1 and 5 name top88 but do not reproduce its update rule or damping parameters; Appendix 9 contains only the CNN implementation.",
      "readings": [
        "Optimality-criteria update with square-root damping",
        "Optimality-criteria update with damping exponent 1/3",
        "MMA update"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Per-iteration density move limit",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The top88 inputs reported in Sec. 5 do not include a density move limit or state which default was retained.",
      "readings": [
        "Maximum absolute density change per iteration = 0.20",
        "Maximum absolute density change per iteration = 0.10",
        "Maximum absolute density change per iteration = 0.05"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Volume-multiplier or optimization-subproblem tolerance",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (4) states the volume inequality, but Secs. 4.1 and 5 give no numerical tolerance for enforcing it or solving an update subproblem.",
      "readings": [
        "OC multiplier bisection stops at relative bracket width 1e-3",
        "OC multiplier bisection stops at relative bracket width 1e-6",
        "Update subproblem enforces relative volume feasibility within 1e-8"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "TO stopping criterion and iteration cap",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No top88 termination rule is reported. Sec. 5's maxit = 100 belongs to TOPress, while the 2000 epochs in Sec. 7.1.1 concern CNN training.",
      "readings": [
        "Stop when maximum density change is below 0.01, with a 200-iteration cap",
        "Stop when maximum density change is below 0.001, with a 1000-iteration cap",
        "Stop after exactly 100 TO iterations"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Elastic equilibrium solution method and accuracy",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (4) specifies Ku = F but the supplied text gives no linear-solver method or residual tolerance.",
      "readings": [
        "Sparse direct factorization",
        "Preconditioned conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 1e-6",
        "Preconditioned conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 1e-10"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    }
  ]
}
